resolution.note: brief check refuses CRLF/BOM text-grammar claims without a fixture literal

title: Refuse a brief that claims CRLF or BOM handling without a fixture in its observer
body: Outcome: krn brief check refuses a brief whose Hardening text-grammar answer claims CRLF (or BOM) handling while the Proof observer file contains no such fixture (no '\r\n' / '\uFEFF' literal). Evidence: PR #196 attempt 1 prepass FAIL 'CRLF residual lines are changed to LF' — the lead's own brief claimed 'CRLF lines stay verbatim' with no CRLF fixture; PR #195 attempt 1 failed on the same class (claimed shape without fixture). Proof: test/brief/allowed-paths.test.ts or a new observer red at base by assertion.
